ui_bugs.issue: React Native Invariant Violation: 'Changing onViewableItemsChanged on the fly is not supported' fires when opening /classifica in feed mode. The dev error overlay/toast is triggered and can obstruct interaction. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/classifica.tsx:81-84 — onViewableItemsChanged is provided as viewRef.current (a ref initialized with an inline function). RN/Web requires a stable useCallback + memoized viewabilityConfig, OR use viewabilityConfigCallbackPairs (also refs). Consider: const onViewableChanged = useCallback(({viewableItems})=>{...},[]); const viewConfig = useRef({itemVisiblePercentThreshold:80}).current; then pass onViewableChanged directly.

PAGEERROR: 'Failed to load because no supported source was found' fires for every FeedItem videoFileUrl on web preview. This is expo-video web limitation; consider showing a graceful poster fallback on web (Platform.OS === 'web') instead of mounting VideoView, or set nativeControls and handle onError. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/classifica.tsx:212-231.

rca_of_issue: Classifica red screen: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/classifica.tsx the FlatList in feed mode is passed onViewableItemsChanged={viewRef.current} where viewRef = useRef(inlineFn). While useRef itself is stable, React Native's VirtualizedList inspects the *identity* of the callback across renders and, in Fabric/Web, flags any perceived change. The reliable pattern is either (a) `const onViewableItemsChanged = useCallback((info) => {...}, []);` passed directly, or (b) `viewabilityConfigCallbackPairs` provided via useRef of an array. Reproduce: open app → login → tap Classifica tab. Mitigation: convert viewRef/viewConfig to useCallback + useRef(config).current.
